tooltip.lagna: Ascendant sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth; defines House 1.
tooltip.rashi: Sidereal zodiac sign occupied by the Moon or a planet (30 degrees each).
tooltip.nakshatra: One of 27 lunar mansions (13 degrees 20 minutes each) along the ecliptic.
tooltip.pada: One of four quarters (3 degrees 20 minutes each) within a Nakshatra, corresponding to Navamsa (D9).
tooltip.navamsa: 9th divisional chart (D9) used in Parashari Jyotish to examine planetary strength and partnerships.
tooltip.ayanamsa: Angular precession difference between tropical and sidereal zodiacs (Lahiri default).
tooltip.dasha: Vimshottari 120-year planetary period system anchored to Moon's birth Nakshatra.
tooltip.antardasha: Sub-period within a major planetary period (Mahadasha).
tooltip.tithi: Lunar day defined by each 12-degree elongation between Moon and Sun at sunrise.
tooltip.yoga: Luni-solar angular sum divided into 27 segments, or a specific planetary combination in a chart.
tooltip.karana: Half of a Tithi (6-degree Moon-Sun elongation).
tooltip.rahu_kaal: One of eight daily daytime segments traditionally avoided for initiating new ventures.
tooltip.abhijit: Midday Muhurat around local solar noon traditionally considered supportive for constructive action.
tooltip.sade_sati: 7.5-year transit of Saturn through the 12th, 1st, and 2nd houses from natal Moon.
tooltip.ashtakoota: Traditional 36-point Moon-based compatibility framework across 8 Koota categories.
trust.about_calculations: Steps 1 to 6 (geocoding, historical timezones, Swiss Ephemeris positions, Lahiri Ayanamsa, Whole-Sign houses, D9 Navamsa, Panchang, and Vimshottari Dasha) are deterministic mathematical calculations.
trust.about_interpretations: Steps 7 to 9 match chart placements against advisor-reviewed classical Parashari rules. Interpretations are traditional perspectives, never guaranteed or scientifically validated.
trust.about_ledger: Our Prediction Ledger is a pre-registered calibration log tracking how often users report stated outcomes over time.
trust.professional_advice_disclaimer: Astroplan readings are for cultural and reflective guidance only. Always consult qualified medical, financial, legal, or mental-health professionals for important life decisions.
